svg.desc: Original educational schematic; not a photograph or exact reconstruction. Original detached pinnate fossil-leaf schematic for the leaf genus Pseudoctenis, not a modern cycad, whole plant, invented trunk or species-level diagnosis of P. spectabilis. No exact specimen shape, venation or annual presence is asserted.
